QUOTE: Async `entropic.ask` worker | `src/facade/external_bridge.cpp:1158` | Detached | ... Detached async workers can outlive the handle. The worker in `run_async_ask` captures `this` (the bridge) and `handle_`... It is detached and not tracked. `ExternalBridge::stop()` drains only the client threads... I found no wait for async workers on that path.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the detached thread (all others are joined) and notes it is untracked with no join, so it outlives its caller and the handle.
